summary: Warren Robinett's Atari 2600 landmark, preserved in an official modern collection.

entries.title: Adventure

emulation.emulator: Digital Eclipse's Atari 50 emulator; Stella as fallback
emulation.notes: Use an owned collection or legally dumped cartridge image.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Cycle-accurate-style 2600 presentation at clean integer scaling; real CRT output remains the artifact-authentic option.

primary.why: Atari 50 provides a currently sold, official emulated copy of Adventure together with its manual and historical context. The underlying game is unchanged, so the modern collection offers clean output and easy access without sacrificing content.
primary.how_to_play: Use Atari 50 on PC at native display output. Keep the emulated image at its correct aspect ratio and use the collection's original documentation; do not add smoothing that blurs the Atari 2600 pixels.

secondary.platform: Atari 2600 via Stella or original hardware
secondary.exclusive_content: No exclusive content; this is the preservation fallback for the original cartridge image.
secondary.what_to_play: Use a legally dumped cartridge in Stella, or the original cartridge on real hardware.
secondary.why: This is the closest artifact-level fallback if the Atari 50 collection is unavailable.

all_releases.reason: secondary: authentic artifact or preservation-emulation fallback, but less convenient than the official current collection.

all_releases.platform: Windows / PS4 / PS5 / Xbox One / Xbox Series / Switch / Atari VCS (Atari 50)
all_releases.fidelity: Official modern emulation with archival documentation.
all_releases.reason: primary: current purchase, complete original game, clean scaling, and historical material in one package.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Atari 50 emulates the original rather than redrawing or altering it.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is emulation, not a remaster. Preserve the original aspect and hard pixel edges; visual filters are optional presentation changes, not upgrades to the artwork.
